name: Studio Arts
notes: Twelve courses, typically declared prior to the junior year. Portfolio submission is not required for enrollment.
No more than two transferred studio courses are accepted toward the major.

SART 396 (fall only) and SART 397 (spring only) must be taken in the SAME academic year, both in the senior year, and SART 397 should not be taken concurrently with any other 200/300-level studio. The app schedules them but does not enforce the same-year or concurrency rules.
Majors must present a senior exhibition (SART 399) with a defense; documentation is retained by the department. The exhibition is not modeled as one of the twelve courses.
Honors requires a 3.5 GPA within the major - not modeled.
